blocks.raw: # Member Care (Old UI)
blocks.text: Member Care (Old UI)

blocks.raw: The Member Care page provides the complete details of a customer.
blocks.text: The Member Care page provides the complete details of a customer.

blocks.raw: # Introduction
blocks.text: Introduction

blocks.raw: Member Care is an application that offers a 360 view of the customer and also acts as a request management portal for support needs. It enables teams to effortlessly access and oversee customer accounts. Member care can be used by both external and internal users.
blocks.text: Member Care is an application that offers a 360 view of the customer and also acts as a request management portal for support needs. It enables teams to effortlessly access and oversee customer accounts. Member care can be used by both external and internal users.

blocks.raw: **External users**:
blocks.text: External users:

blocks.raw:
* Customer support team: They can view customer details, handle service requests such as Identifier Change and Account Merge, and monitor real-time customer events for troubleshooting purposes.
* Marketing team: They can get a 360-degree view of customer data and plan campaigns.
blocks.text: Customer support team: They can view customer details, handle service requests such as Identifier Change and Account Merge, and monitor real-time customer events for troubleshooting purposes.Marketing team: They can get a 360-degree view of customer data and plan campaigns.

blocks.raw: **Internal users**:
blocks.text: Internal users:

blocks.raw:
* System integrators and Customer Success Managers (CSM): They use Member Care to verify the ingestion of customer-level event data. They can instantly check operations performed for a customer.
* Support team: The Capillary support team utilizes Member Care to troubleshoot and resolve customer tickets, addressing any issues the customer may encounter.

blocks.raw: ## Searching for a customer or group
blocks.text: Searching for a customer or group

blocks.raw: You can search for a customer or a group by searching from  **Search** on the Member Care home page or by clicking on the **Search** icon on the details page.

blocks.raw: ## Sharing new profile link
blocks.text: Sharing new profile link

blocks.raw: To share the new Member Care UI, use url *\{host URL}/member-care/ui/*.
blocks.text: To share the new Member Care UI, use url {host URL}/member-care/ui/.

blocks.raw: To share or view the customer page in the new UI, use url *\{host URL}/member-care/ui/\{userId}*.
blocks.text: To share or view the customer page in the new UI, use url {host URL}/member-care/ui/{userId}.

blocks.raw: For example,  <https://eucrm.cc.capillarytech.com/member-care/ui/172076358>.
blocks.text: For example,  https://eucrm.cc.capillarytech.com/member-care/ui/172076358.

blocks.raw: ## Sharing old UI profile link
blocks.text: Sharing old UI profile link

blocks.raw: You can share the old UI customer profile link directly. To share, use the url *\{host}/memberCare/search/Customer?oldFlow=true*.
blocks.text: You can share the old UI customer profile link directly. To share, use the url {host}/memberCare/search/Customer?oldFlow=true.

blocks.raw: For example, <https://eucrm.cc.capillarytech.com/memberCare/search/Customer?id=172076358&oldFlow=true>
blocks.text: For example, https://eucrm.cc.capillarytech.com/memberCare/search/Customer?id=172076358&oldFlow=true

blocks.raw: > ❗️ You must use oldFlow=true parameter to directly navigate to the old UI search page. If you use the same URL without the oldFlow parameter, you will be redirected to the new Customer Search page.
